question: Atlanta took Matt Ryan third overall in the 2008 NFL Draft. Which quarterback was the next one selected, at No. 18?
explanation: Baltimore took Flacco out of Delaware, and no other quarterback went until the second round, when Green Bay took Brohm at 56 and Miami took Henne at 57.

question: Desmond Howard's diving fourth-down touchdown catch sealed Michigan's 24-14 win over Notre Dame in September 1991. Who threw it?
explanation: The 25-yard grab, known in Ann Arbor as 'The Catch', launched Howard's Heisman season.

question: During Marshawn Lynch's 67-yard 'Beast Quake' run against New Orleans in January 2011, which Saints cornerback did he stiff-arm to the ground?
explanation: Lynch broke nine tackles on the run, which sealed Seattle's 41-36 wild-card upset of the defending champions. Porter had been the hero of Super Bowl 44 a year earlier.

question: Which Patriot intercepted Donovan McNabb in the final minute to seal New England's 24-21 win over Philadelphia in Super Bowl 39?
explanation: It was the safety's second pick of the night. Bruschi had the Patriots' other interception, in the fourth quarter.

question: Ron Dayne broke Ricky Williams' NCAA career rushing record in Wisconsin's final regular-season game of 1999. Which team were the Badgers playing?
explanation: Dayne finished with 6,397 official yards; the NCAA did not count bowl games then, and with his four bowls he had 7,125.

question: Tim Tebow's leaping 4-yard touchdown pass with 3:07 left sealed Florida's 24-14 win over Oklahoma in the January 2009 BCS title game. Who caught it?
explanation: Florida's defense held Sam Bradford's high-scoring Sooners to 14 points and intercepted him twice, and Tebow was named the game's most outstanding player.

question: Facing fourth-and-inches deep in his own territory late in the 1996 Big 12 Championship Game, Texas quarterback James Brown rolled left and hit which tight end for 61 yards to set up the clinching score against Nebraska?
explanation: Priest Holmes then ran 11 yards for the touchdown with 1:53 left, and Texas won 37-27 to knock Nebraska out of the national title race.

question: On the last play of the January 1996 AFC Championship Game, Jim Harbaugh's Hail Mary bounced off the body and hands of which Colts receiver in the Pittsburgh end zone?
explanation: Steelers Randy Fuller, Myron Bell and Darren Perry collided with Bailey to jar it loose, and the incompletion held up on replay as Pittsburgh won 20-16.

question: The Rams traded Jerome Bettis to Pittsburgh on draft day in April 1996. Whom did St. Louis select with the second-round pick, No. 59 overall, that it got in the deal?
explanation: The Rams also got a 1997 fourth-rounder, later swapped with Miami for the pick used on Ryan Tucker, while Bettis ran his way to the Hall of Fame.

question: Colorado beat Michigan in Ann Arbor in September 1994 when a teammate deliberately batted the final-play heave to Michael Westbrook. Which Buffaloes receiver made that tip?
explanation: On the play, called 'Rocket Left', Westbrook, Anderson and Carruth lined up wide left with Kidd on the right. Colorado had trailed 26-21 with six seconds left.
